producer_report.summary: Added an owner decision briefs page. `xtask site` now also writes `decisions.html` next to `index.html`, and the index links to it. New module `xtask/src/decisions.rs` resolves the records tip with `resolve_tip`. It lists work items, work decisions and role records with `ls_tree_under`, reads them in one `cat_blobs` call, and parses each with `check_record_file`. The open Steward proposals are the proposal work items that no work decision names. Each brief shows the title, the rung and role, the source, the first evidence pointer, a link to the record, and the approve-work and reject-work commands. The recommendation line comes from the raising role's newest recorded version and its `highest_rung`, checked with `may_change`. That gives four exact lines: role not recorded (Decide yourself); rung in the top two (Decide yourself); rung above the role's limit (Decide yourself); within the limit ("Athena approves it without you; check only if you disagree"). Links are `Pin { base: ATHENA_URL, sha: records tip }` through `source_url`. A brief over 120 words, or with an empty recommendation, is an error, and so is the page that holds it. A missing records branch, or a root that is not a git repository, gives a page saying no proposals could be listed and that this does not mean none are waiting. `docs/conventions/owner-style.md` and a CHANGELOG entry are added. The root cause of the old wrong "Decide yourself" advice was guessing the limit. It is now read from the role records with the same rule `athena-core` uses.

checks_run.note: 61 unit tests plus the integration binaries, including policy (17), site_page (5), ci_shards, fingerprint, spec and walltime. All pass.
Ran to format; no diff check was run separately.

The brief gave only these two phrases, not the full paragraph, so any text the owner's paragraph holds beyond them is not reproduced. See open_issues.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test builds briefs from two fixture proposals with different title, rung, source and evidence and asserts the briefs differ, with no fixed cost, risk or 'Approve'.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::briefs_from_different_proposals_differ_and_carry_no_fixed_cost_risk_or_approve passes in `cargo test -p xtask`. It asserts the two briefs differ, and that neither contains 'Approve', 'cost' or 'risk'. The fixtures differ in title, rung and evidence. Both fixtures share one source, so the source is not asserted to differ.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: with role fixtures, one proposal within the role's limit and one above it at the same rung produce exact, different recommendation lines; the in-limit one does not say 'Decide yourself', and a proposal with an unrecorded role says the role is not recorded.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::the_recommendation_follows_the_limit_in_the_role_records passes. It uses assert_eq on the exact lines for the steward role (newest version 2, within the limit) and the reader role (above it) at rung defaults-conventions, and on the 'nobody role is not recorded' line. It also checks the in-limit line does not contain 'Decide yourself'.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test asserts every record link in the briefs begins with the Athena GitHub base (ATHENA_URL) and contains the records tip sha, and no href is relative.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::every_record_link_is_absolute_on_the_athena_base_with_the_records_tip passes. It collects every href on the page, asserts there are exactly 2, and asserts each starts with ATHENA_URL/blob/<tip>/records/work-items/. The read test also shows the real records tip sha in the link.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a brief over about 120 words of prose is refused with an error, and a brief with no recommendation line is refused with an error. Expected 0% of newly refused readings outside the new renderer.
criteria_check.evidence: decisions::tests::a_long_brief_and_a_brief_without_a_recommendation_are_refused passes. A 130-word title gives the error 'words of prose'; a 60-word title is accepted; an empty recommendation gives the error 'no recommendation'; and `render_page` is refused when it holds such a brief. The check lives only in `render_brief`, and all pre-existing site, policy and other tests still pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a proposal with no evidence renders an explicit 'not recorded' statement, and a checkout without the records branch lists no proposals and the page says so rather than reporting success.
criteria_check.evidence: The first test asserts 'Evidence: not recorded.' for the proposal with no evidence. decisions::tests::a_checkout_without_the_records_branch_says_so_and_lists_nothing builds a real git repo with no records branch. It asserts the page says 'The records branch is not in this checkout' and 'does not mean none are waiting', has no '<article', and lacks 'No proposals are waiting.'. A directory that is not a repository gives the same page.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: the rendered index contains a link to the decisions page, build() writes the decisions page next to index.html, and existing study page tests still pass unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: site::tests::the_index_links_to_the_decisions_page_and_build_writes_it_beside_the_index passes. It checks the index contains href="decisions.html" and that build() writes index.html and decisions.html into the same directory. No existing test was edited, and the existing site::tests and tests/site_page.rs tests all pass.

open_issues: The owner's full style paragraph was not in the brief, only two phrases from it. owner-style.md quotes those two sentences exactly and adds a short list of how the decisions page applies them. If the paragraph has more sentences, they need to be pasted in verbatim.

A valid proposal always carries evidence, because WorkItem::validate requires it for non-blind-spot items. The 'Evidence: not recorded.' line therefore only appears for a hand-built Brief or a record that skipped validation. It is a defensive statement, shown in the renderer test.
The records link points to the work item file on the records branch at the records tip, under the Athena GitHub repository. That only resolves if the records branch is published there.
mistakes: The first test compile failed on a JobId parse call and on fixture ids with invalid base32 letters. I fixed the fixtures and reran.
The read test first wrote a proposal with no evidence; validation refused it. I added evidence to the written copy.
The first version of the error mapping repeated the file path in the error text. I removed my extra prefix.
learnings: `RecordId` suffixes are four lowercase Crockford base32 characters, so the letters i, l, o and u are invalid in fixture ids.
`WorkItem::validate` requires evidence on proposals, so test records written to the records branch need at least one evidence reference.
`Git::isolated` plus `RecordsWriter::append` creates a records branch in a fresh empty repo with no initial commit, so xtask tests need no testutil, which is crate-private to athena-git.
`site::build` is called by an existing test on a non-git temp directory, so the decisions step has to treat a root without `.git` as having no records branch rather than fail.
`xtask/tests/site_page.rs` runs the real `xtask site` binary, which now also reads this checkout's git for the decisions page.
desires: The owner's style paragraph in full, as text in the brief.
A way to run `cargo fmt --all --check` and the full workspace tests without the one-shot restriction, to confirm the final state.
